title: Am I walking into eternity along Sandymount strand? Crush, crack, crick, crick
html_source:
Stephen wonders if he can transcend the phenomenal world to the noumenal. He still hears the sound of his feet from the real world suggesting he hasn’t having a little pop at Blake as he walks on the detritus.
